abort.single_instance_allowed: Punch Clock is already set up.

user.title: Punch Clock
user.description: Punch Clock adds a weekly calendar to the sidebar. Use it to schedule entity values, such as thermostat temperatures or light brightness.

data.require_admin: Only administrators can use Punch Clock

data_description.require_admin: When this is off, every user can see and edit the schedules.

write_budget.title: Punch Clock paused writes to {target}
write_budget.description: Punch Clock changed {target} more than 6 times in 10 minutes, so it stopped writing to it for 10 minutes. This usually means a block's conditions keep switching between true and false, for example because a condition checks an entity that the same schedule controls. Review the conditions in the Punch Clock panel.

temperature_unit_changed.title: Temperature unit changed
temperature_unit_changed.description: Home Assistant's temperature unit changed from {old} to {new}. Punch Clock doesn't convert scheduled temperatures. Review the temperatures in your schedules, then dismiss this message.
